hero.p: Amanar n unelmad n tsga n uzref d tsrtant n Agaḍir — aseggas n tɣuri 2026-2027. Aru ism n twacult-inek, tafeḍ tagrawt-inek d uɣawas n wakud-inek s tifsin.
hero.chip: Asmel asuf, war unṣib · Aɣbalu amaddud d asmel n tsga
nav.title: Tibḍiwin n usmel
uni.banner: ⚠️ Tabdart war unṣib: isɣunen ttwaṭṭfen seg usmel amaddud n tsdawit i tinawt. Aɣbalu amaddud d asmel n tsdawit.
uni.intro: Tasdawit {{Ibn Zohr}} tesserɣ 24 n tmaddasin (tisgiwin d tinmal) deg Agaḍir, Ayt Mellul d tɣiwanin-nniḍen, ɣas akken iɣsan-is d yimassanen-is i yinelmaden.
uni.cat.fac: Tisgiwin n Agaḍir d Ayt Mellul
uni.note: Tamatart: «Tasga n uzref d tsrtant» ur tettwabdar s yism-a deg tabdart n tsdawit; aqrib d «Tasga n tussniwin tizrfanin, tidamsanin d tinmettiyin» n Agaḍir. Ssentes ɣef usmel amaddud.
uni.form.intro: Nadi tiɣuriwin timaddudin n tsdawit {{Ibn Zohr}} s yism, tamaddast, tɣiwant neɣ diplom.
uni.form.hint: Aru awal i unadi n 382 n tɣuriwin.
uni.form.more: Ttwaskan kan 80 n igmaden imezwura — snejdel anadi-inek.
uni.form.note: Ismawen n tiɣuriwin s tafransist am deg uɣbalu amaddud. Asɣun yeldi tsebtart n tɣuri deg usmel n tsdawit.
stats.lead: Tamuɣli ɣef ugbur n usmel: ibrdan, tiɣriwin, iselmaden, tixxamin, tusniwin, isnilsen d bḍu n tgrawin. Imḍanen ttwaḥsaben seg isefka yettwaskanen.
learn.lead: Senṭeḍ aḍris n tɣuri-inek da → tafeḍ agzul amussnan, tiqziyin, tikarda n usmekti d uɣawas n usemti. Yetteddu iman-is.
learn.tips: Awali: ssentes ɣef uɣawas n wakud-inek deg tzegzawt-is, daɣen ssentes ɣef lqem amaddud n tsga.
ann.error: Ur yezmir ara ad d-yali isallen n usmel tura.

note.after: Ism n twacult yusa-d deffir uneggaru yettwaskanen; agmuḍ d aqrib.

about.body: Anelmad deg tsga n uzref d tsrtant deg Agaḍir (Tasdawit {{Ibn Zohr}}), azref asuf (s tɛrabt). Yemmun tayri n uzref, tira d tetiknulujit, yebna {{CHRVVIM}} i users n talɣut tazrfan yettwamanen ɣer yal anelmad.

legal.head: Tamatart tazrfan — asmel asuf, war unṣib
legal.p1: Asmel-a d tudart n yinelmaden tufrin sɣur {{Mohamed Chraim}}. Mačči d asmel amaddud n tsga n tussniwin tizrfanin d tisrtanin (Tasdawit {{Ibn Zohr}}), ur tt-imeslay ara s wuma.
legal.p2: Isefka yettwaskanen (iɣawasen n wakud, tigrawin, ibrdan, isnilsen) ttwaṭṭfen seg isnilsen d yisalien imadduden, i usentem kan. Aɣbalu amaddud n unu d asmel n tsga d isnilsen-is aneṣliyen; ma yella amxallaf, lqem amaddud a t-ttwassemɣer.
legal.archive: Tikwipi n isnilsen imadduden tettwasekles i usentem. Dima senqed aɣbalu amaddud i usemti aneggaru.
